name: NUT JOB | Nut, Bolt, Washer and Threaded Rod Factory

captions.detailed: A 3D model of a standard hex head bolt. It features a flat, hexagonal head at the base and a long, fully threaded cylindrical shaft extending upwards. The threads are sharp and uniform, with a slight chamfer at the top tip of the bolt.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric OpenSCAD script for generating standard hardware components including bolts, nuts, washers, and threaded rods. The user should be able to configure the component type, thread pitch, thread diameter, length, and head style (such as a hex head or socket cap).
captions.factory: The script uses conditional blocks to determine the active component type. When configured as a hex bolt, it calls the `hex_screw` module, which generates the hexagonal head using a cylinder primitive with 6 facets (customizable via the `facets` parameter) and pairs it with a threaded shaft generated by a helical thread library. The thread geometry is defined by `thread_outer_diameter`, `thread_step`, and `step_shape_degrees`.
